# Shared repository rules

Read `AGENTS.md` and `docs/STRUCTURE.md` before editing. Use `projects.json` to register projects, preserve public URLs and publish only `site/`. Keep private work and application source outside this checkout. For WoW guides also read `docs/WOW-AUTHORING.md`. Run the commands in `CONTRIBUTING.md` before finishing. The detailed rules belong in AGENTS.md.
